evidence_snippet: Custom SoCs are explicitly positioned for data center/networking, automotive, smart-device and industrial applications.
SHIFT discloses end-to-end software quality assurance and more than 3,000 customer companies as of April 2024.
ZENRIN describes a company-information database covering about five million records linked to building-level location data.
Fujikura discloses optical-fiber cabling solutions designed for data-center racks and space efficiency.
TOWA's integrated report identifies semiconductor sales of JPY39.53bn in FY2025 and links compression molding to advanced packages for generative AI.
SCREEN identifies semiconductor production equipment and world-leading wet etch and clean equipment as core businesses.
DISCO supplies precision cutting grinding and polishing equipment plus consumable tools mainly to semiconductor and electronic-component manufacturers.
Lasertec states that EUV mask blank inspection is a de facto standard and its inspection systems are crucial to semiconductor manufacturing.
Daikin discloses dedicated data-center cooling systems for 24-hour server protection and energy-efficient operation.
Yokogawa states that more than 30,000 systems use its distributed-control systems for industrial production goals.
Digital Arts discloses integrated web email and file security products and patents in 27 countries and regions.
FFRI discloses endpoint security managed services and automated malware-analysis products based on domestic core security R&D.
Organo states that its ultrapure-water systems serve semiconductor plants at capacities up to 1,000 cubic metres per hour.
DAIHEN discloses transformers and distribution equipment together with factory-automation robots and semiconductor plasma RF generators.
